tolerance_selection: absolute clean-RGB MSE thresholds fixed before evaluation; calibration checks do not tune them
metric: mean squared target-patch prediction discrepancy from same model dense prediction
reduction: query average within image, images within class, then equal class average; threshold after aggregation
crossing: smallest k passing tolerance at every larger k, using reverse cumulative maximum
geometry: nearest first: Chebyshev distance, squared Euclidean distance, token index; no protected 3x3 core
precision: FP32, TF32 disabled, deterministic math SDPA, TORCHDYNAMO_DISABLE=1
sharding: two even/odd image shards per model; 4 GPU workers total

extension.primary_metric: masked clean-target MSE minus dense clean-target MSE
